sample_unit: staging assessments (6 radiologists x 12 simulated cases x 1 per condition, per condition 72)

links.outcome: Staging accuracy and time for radiologists unassisted vs LLM-assisted vs KBA-assisted
links.effect: Accuracy 81.9%, 80.6%, 98.6% (unassisted, LLM-assisted, KBA-assisted); KBA higher than both (p<0.001); staging time 229.2, 401.9, 196.2 s; LLM increased time without improving accuracy.
links.quote: In a preliminary comparative experiment, KBA assistance improved staging accuracy without increasing staging time, whereas LLM assistance increased staging time without improving staging accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Exhaustive verification of rule-based guideline algorithm outputs across all possible inputs
Using deterministic knowledge-based algorithms instead of LLMs for rule-governed guideline tasks

screen.reason: Empirically tests radiologists' staging performance across three reader conditions: unassisted, retrieval-augmented LLM-assisted, and knowledge-based algorithm-assisted.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation assistance vs rule-based decision support
